## Shadow Review (blinded) — PR #1919 (issue #1911)

**Verdict: APPROVE**

### Diff classification
`engine_self_modifying` (lib/** touched: lib/test/run.sh, lib/test/modules/coverage-map.json) → full Phase 1+2 checklist, `checklist_skipped=null`. small_diff=false (6 files, >100 lines), config_only=false (.sh present), has_new_types=false. Phase 3 roster gated by applicability: four always-on + pr-test-analyzer (run.sh is a test file); type-design-analyzer skipped (has_new_types false).

### The change
Adds one `::warning::` block (warn, never refuse) to the byte-identical "Inject provider endpoint" step in `.github/workflows/{devflow,devflow-implement,devflow-runner}.yml`, firing when a provider `env` map names any of ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL / API_TIMEOUT_MS / HOME / RUNNER_TEMP. Extends the #1773 test block in `lib/test/run.sh` (and re-anchors the R1773_KEYS deny-key sed extraction to `/denied_env_keys=/` so the new second `IN(...)` line is not swept into the deny refusal loop), adds a coverage-map entry and a patch changeset. Schema/docs deferred to implement Phase 4.1 (out of this PR's scope).

### Phase 2 checklist
No FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE items. The load-bearing claims were independently confirmed: (a) inject step runs under `set -euo pipefail`, so the bare-assignment discipline propagates a jq failure rather than swallowing it; (b) the warn block is placed strictly after the deny guard's `exit 1` (deny-before-warn); (c) the two `ascii_upcase | IN(...)` lines are disambiguated by address anchoring; (d) the three-workflow byte-identity of the new block is covered by the pre-existing #313 body-identity check.

### Phase 3 findings
Two Suggestion-level (test_gap) observations from pr-test-analyzer, both optional hardening — no Critical or Important. No documented_falsehood: the changeset text, the warning message, and the added comments all verified true against HEAD.

1. (Suggestion) ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL write-back test asserts presence but not supersession of the dedicated field; last-wins is pre-existing #1770 behavior and the new code is advisory-only. `lib/test/run.sh` ~L134-135.
2. (Suggestion) All new cases use SECTION=prflow_implement; no added negative-section assertion. Mirrors existing coverage shape, not introduced here. `lib/test/run.sh` warn block region.

### Consumer review-extension policy
- No newly-added wording-only / prose-presence / comment-presence pin: the added test assertions are behavioral (drive the real extracted step body under bash -c), and the exact-set assertion reads the watched keys out of the live body. No `# structural-pin-ok:` needed.
- Guard-class shapes: tr-dependence is cosmetic (key-list splitting, not selection); the vacuous-negative-test check passes (removing the warn block turns the exact-set and per-key assertions RED); probes run under the artifact's real interpreter (set -e/pipefail included in $R313_INJ_BODY).
- Prompt-surface edit-routing gate: this PR touches none of the trigger globs → no finding.

### Verdict rationale
All eight acceptance criteria are met and covered by executable tests that fail-closed on drift. The only findings are two optional Suggestions, below the REJECT threshold. **APPROVE.**
